paragraphs: R' Tanhum bar Hanilai: Ta'anit 7b; Bava Metzia 86b; Makkot 10a. In Avodah Zarah 18, end of side b: R' Hanilai bar Hanilai said that anyone who scoffs causes destruction. But Ein Yaakov and Yalkut Isaiah 28 have this matter as R' Tanhum bar Hanilai; בשס״ח [provisionally the new Talmud editions; uncollated] did not correct it. He, R' Abba bar Zavdai, and R' Yoshiyah decreed a fast and expounded, and so forth: Eikhah Rabbah, at “Let us search our ways.” In that matter in Jerusalem Ta'anit, beginning of chapter 2: R' Tanhum bar Illai and R' Abba, and so forth. He gave half his food to the poor: Yelammedenu, Mishpatim. Rav Aha was his brother; see under Hanilai for his other brothers. In R' Berekhiah's name. In R' Yohanan's name: Yelammedenu, Tazria. R' Hanina ben Agol went to him. He frequented R' Yehoshua ben Levi: Bava Kamma, chapter 1. R' Pinhas reports in his name [source: כשמו, evidently for בשמו]: Jerusalem Ha-Ro'eh, mishnah 1. Shmuel ben Nahum reports in his name. In Shevuot 36, end of side a: Tanhum bar Hakhinai. In Yevamot 62b: “R' Tanhum said: Hanilai said.” It appears to be a scribal error and should read bar Hanilai.
